description: Superseded historical Candidate TP4 recipe for the unpruned GLM 5.2 Int4/Int8 checkpoint. It is unsupported on Vonk's current one- or two-Spark configuration: a two-rank split alone would require at least 202.8 GB of checkpoint bytes per Spark before KV cache or runtime overhead, above the roughly 126.9 GB-per-node inventory. The immutable contract remains installable for reproducibility; its archived upstream directs four-node users to DFlash, while glm-5-3-flash-exl3-dflash2-tensorfold-mia-dual is the current 126 GB-admission-envelope GLM alternative. Memory follows the creator's settings: GPU memory utilization 0.86, a 7,008,000,000-byte KV pin and a 128,000-token context, drowzeys' recipe/serve.env.example at 296699b4 (lines 7-9; serve/launch-keyspark.sh line 72 calls 0.86 the approved GLM-5.2 ceiling). The larger pool and the capped context came from offline memory fits (#1647, #1702, #1715), not from a hardware run. The declared peak is an estimate until the run measures it.
title: GLM 5.2 QuantTrio four Sparks (superseded)
